listing.name: Point & Shoot
listing.shortDescription: Point at or drag a box around a broken element, add a note, export a fix prompt.
listing.currentVersionSummary: Capture annotated UI evidence and export a local fix prompt from Chrome or Firefox.
listing.fullDescription:
Point & Shoot turns interface problems into local evidence a coding agent can act on. Start a capture from the browser toolbar or keyboard shortcut, point at a broken element or drag around a region, add a note, and repeat across as many pages as needed.

Each capture can include a screenshot, page URL, selector fallbacks, relevant page text and metadata, a bounded computed-style digest, and the note you wrote. Review the session in the browser side panel, choose which notes to include, then export an agent-readable Markdown prompt or ZIP bundle.

Point & Shoot keeps extension data on your device. It does not upload captures, notes, screenshots, browsing information, or exported bundles. The extension requests temporary active-tab access only after you invoke it and does not request persistent access to every site. All executable code is packaged with the extension.

Current version

Capture annotated UI evidence and export a local fix prompt from Chrome or Firefox.

Browser support

Chrome 116 or newer and Firefox 109 or newer are supported. Safari support is planned separately.

Support

Send support requests to support@pointandshoot.app.

privacy.singlePurpose: Point & Shoot lets a user select a UI problem on the active page, annotate it, and export local visual and structural evidence for a coding agent.

permissions.activeTab: Temporarily accesses only the active tab after the user invokes Point & Shoot, so it can inspect the selected region and capture the visible page. It does not request persistent host access.
permissions.storage: Saves extension settings and session pointers locally. Captures, screenshots, and notes remain in the browser's local IndexedDB storage until the user deletes them.
permissions.scripting: Injects the packaged capture interface into the active tab after an explicit user gesture. It does not download or execute remote code.
permissions.downloads: Creates a Markdown prompt or ZIP bundle only when the user chooses an export action.
permissions.clipboardWrite: Copies the compiled prompt only when the user selects Copy prompt. The extension cannot read clipboard contents.
permissions.sidePanel: Opens the Chrome review workspace where the user edits notes, compiles the prompt, and starts an export.

handledLocally.description: Text, images, links, element metadata, and styles from only the active page and selected region are processed locally to create the capture.
The active page URL is stored locally with a capture so the exported evidence identifies where the problem appeared.
Selection and click activity used to choose a capture is processed locally and is not used to monitor general browsing.
Notes written by the user are stored locally with the capture until the user deletes the session.
